expected.goal: Create the end-to-end login experience so users can sign in with validated credentials, see clear inline error states, and remain on the page when authentication fails.
Add logout handling that clears the current session, redirects the user to the sign-in screen, and behaves consistently for both manual logout and automatic session expiration.
Implement the product details experience accessible from the inventory page, with consistent cart behavior and state synchronization between the inventory and product pages.
